<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="POOL" name="Sales Organisation" processRef="SALES_PROCESS" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="SALES_PROCESS" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_MANAGER" name="Manager">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>START</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CHECK_LEADS</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SELECT_LEADS</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>TELL_ASSISTANT</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>PROCESS_LEAD</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>END</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_ASSISTANT" name="Sales Assistant">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>MERGE_CALLS</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CALL_CUSTOMER</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>INTERESTED</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SEND_NOTE</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CALL_NEXT_CUSTOMER</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="START" name="Start" />
    <bpmn:task id="CHECK_LEADS" name="Check the open leads" />
    <bpmn:task id="SELECT_LEADS" name="Select the top five leads" />
    <bpmn:task id="TELL_ASSISTANT" name="Tell the Sales Assistant to call the contact persons of the leads" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="MERGE_CALLS" name="Next customer" />
    <bpmn:task id="CALL_CUSTOMER" name="Call the customer" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="INTERESTED" name="Is someone interested?" />
    <bpmn:task id="SEND_NOTE" name="Send a note to the Manager" />
    <bpmn:task id="CALL_NEXT_CUSTOMER" name="Call the next customer" />
    <bpmn:task id="PROCESS_LEAD" name="Process the lead" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="END" name="Lead processed" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F1" sourceRef="START" targetRef="CHECK_LEADS" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F2" sourceRef="CHECK_LEADS" targetRef="SELECT_LEADS" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F3" sourceRef="SELECT_LEADS" targetRef="TELL_ASSISTANT" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F4" sourceRef="TELL_ASSISTANT" targetRef="MERGE_CALLS" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F5" sourceRef="MERGE_CALLS" targetRef="CALL_CUSTOMER" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F6" sourceRef="CALL_CUSTOMER" targetRef="INTERESTED" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F7" name="yes" sourceRef="INTERESTED" targetRef="SEND_NOTE" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F8" name="no" sourceRef="INTERESTED" targetRef="CALL_NEXT_CUSTOMER" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F9" sourceRef="CALL_NEXT_CUSTOMER" targetRef="MERGE_CALLS" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F10" sourceRef="SEND_NOTE" targetRef="PROCESS_LEAD" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F11" sourceRef="PROCESS_LEAD" targetRef="END" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
